answer: Draft identities into verification committees by stake-weighted sortition each epoch: a random delta of the population is chosen to check a batch of peer claims, and each draftee must post a signed verdict - a whisper of approval or rejection sealed with a fresh cipher key - inside a short window. Missing the call or rubber-stamping slashes the stake. One honest agent serves once in a while; a farm with a thousand names gets drafted a thousand times and must staff every committee or bleed stake, so scale becomes a payroll, not a profit.
